headline: Executive order creates SelectUSA, a federal program to encourage businesses to invest in the United States.
what_it_does: This order sets up a federal effort called the SelectUSA Initiative. Based on its name, the program is meant to promote the United States as a place for businesses to invest and set up operations. No summary was provided, so details about its structure, staffing, and specific duties are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses, including foreign companies, considering investing in the United States
who_it_affects.how: They may be offered federal help or information as part of an effort to attract investment to the US.
They may be asked to support or coordinate with the new initiative.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 15, 2011; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
